illustrations.text: A gang member pick-pockets commuters: s.112, one to seven years and fine.
A gang member snatches a phone from a pedestrian: s.112.

illustrations.text: A lone thief is not petty organised crime, though theft is punishable separately.
A gang member who commits no listed act is not s.112.
A gang member who does not commit the act is not s.112.
